meta.source: Approved Claude Design canvases (Pantas Web 1440, Pantas Redesign 390) and the app code; review rounds 1 to 4, Nov 7 to 8 2026. Version 4.0.0 (semver).

tokens.name: bg-page
tokens.usage: Page background behind every screen and the sidebar. Text: text-primary, text-secondary. (PantasColors.background)

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Cards, grouped lists, dialogs, popovers, fields, floating bars, the tab bar. Text: text-primary, text-secondary. In dark, pair with edge-card. (PantasColors.surface)

tokens.name: surface-modal
tokens.usage: Dialog and sheet surface. Light equals the card. Dark is one step up (#2A2A2A) so a dialog separates from the dimmed cards behind the scrim. Fields inside keep surface-card. Text: text-primary, text-secondary (5.7:1). New, no dark board (usage gap 24).

tokens.name: surface-inset
tokens.usage: Card footer band and indented rows inside a card, always with a divider rule above. Dark equals the card, as the approved dark board draws it. CHANGE (dark): #2A2A2A to the card value. Text: text-primary, text-secondary. (PantasColors.pickerBackground)

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover well of rows, white buttons and popover items. Text: text-primary, text-secondary. (WebTokens.rowHover)

tokens.name: surface-modal-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and press well inside a Dialog or Sheet. Light equals surface-hover; dark is white at 6% over surface-modal (about #363636 on #2A2A2A, 1.2:1; an alpha literal, because no new gray clears the 2.0 CIEDE2000 rule between #303030 and #3A3A3C), because surface-hover equals surface-modal in dark (R3-O02). The bundle sets it as surface-hover inside .dialog and .sheet. New.

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: Segmented track, progress track, disabled button fill, gray tag, neutral button. Text: text-on-fill. CHANGE (dark): #2A2A2A to #303033 so it differs from surface-hover. (PantasColors.fill)

tokens.name: fill-skeleton
tokens.usage: Skeleton blocks only. Light shares the divider gray; dark is one clear step above the card and the hover well (1.5:1 on the card). CHANGE (dark): #2C2C2C to #3D3D3D (R2-O20); light #E6E6EA folds into #E3E3E8 (R2-O21, invisible). (PantasColors.skeleton) Equal to switch-off by coincidence, not an alias (R3-O13).

tokens.name: surface-segment-on
tokens.usage: Selected segment thumb. Text: text-primary. (PantasColors.segmentOn)

tokens.name: edge-card
tokens.usage: 1px inset edge on cards and grouped lists. Transparent in light, visible in dark. Dark #2C2C2C folds into #2A2A2A (R2-O21, invisible). (PantasColors.cardEdge)

tokens.name: edge-bar
tokens.usage: 1px inset ring of floating bars and the tab bar; elev-bar adds the drop. Light is black at 6%. (webFloatingEdge)

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Body text, titles, row labels. On bg-page, surface-card, surface-inset, surface-hover, accent-bar, danger-bar, fill. (PantasColors.label)

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text, lead lines, row subtitles and values, eyebrows, placeholders, hints, past dates, dimmed content. On bg-page, surface-card, surface-inset, surface-hover. Not on fill (text-on-fill) or accent-tint (text-on-tint-secondary). (PantasColors.secondaryLabel)

tokens.name: text-on-fill
tokens.usage: Secondary text on fill: gray tag, unselected segment labels. 5.1:1 light, 5.2:1 dark. (PantasColors.onFillLabel)

tokens.name: text-on-tint-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text on accent-tint: the subtitle and value of a selected row, the subtitle of a selected tile. 4.6:1 light, 5.4:1 dark.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Labels of disabled controls only, on fill or surface-card. Exempt from 4.5:1 because the control is disabled. Never for readable content. One step below text-secondary in both themes. CHANGE (dark): #949494 to #6B6B6B. (PantasColors.disabledActionLabel, WebTokens.disabledText)

tokens.name: icon-muted
tokens.usage: Inactive nav and tab icons, ghost icons, search glyph. 3:1 on bg-page and surface-card. (nav icon stroke)

tokens.name: icon-chevron
tokens.usage: Row chevrons. 3:1 on white and surface-hover; on accent-tint use accent-tint-text. Light #8F8F93 folds into #8E8E93 (R2-O21, invisible). (PantasColors.chevron)

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: Hairlines, row separators, notice ring, card footer rule, progress ring tracks. Decorative only: never the boundary of a control. (PantasColors.separator)

tokens.name: divider-strong
tokens.usage: Key-hint ring, sheet grabber, half-day dot, question chip ring, hover ring on options and tiles. Decorative only. (WebTokens.strongDivider)

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Boundary of every control a learner must find: fields, search, white buttons, unchecked checkbox and radio, switch off ring, answer letter badge, not-started task marker, select box. 3.4:1 on white, 3.2:1 on bg-page; dark 5.1:1. Hover: text-secondary. (PantasColors.controlOutline)

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Teal text, links, icons, selected rings, focus ring, progress fills, accent-tone ghost buttons. On bg-page, surface-card, surface-hover, accent-bar. (PantasColors.accent)

tokens.name: accent-fill
tokens.usage: Filled teal: primary button, switch on, selected badge, checkbox on, Today disc, done marker. Text on it: on-accent. (PantasColors.accentFill)

tokens.name: accent-fill-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of primary, switch on and checkbox on. Dark value is derived in code (no board value). (WebTokens.accentHover) Dark #0E7967 folds into #0B7A68 (R2-O21, invisible).

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover color of teal text: links, accent ghost labels, tonal label. Dark is the lighter tint text because a dark teal fails on dark grounds. (WebTokens.tintText)

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Tonal button, tag, selected row, correct-answer wash, active tab item. Text on it: accent-tint-text, text-on-tint-secondary. (PantasColors.accentTint)

tokens.name: accent-tint-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of the tonal button; the label switches to accent-hover. Dark value is chosen (code has none). (WebTokens.secondaryHover)

tokens.name: accent-tint-text
tokens.usage: Teal text and icons on accent-tint, including the active tab item. 4.5:1 light, 8.1:1 dark. (PantasColors.accentTintText)

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and marks on accent-fill. (PantasColors.onAccent)

tokens.name: kbd-on-fill
tokens.usage: Key-hint chip inside a primary or critical button: black at 16% under on-accent text (6.9:1 light, 6.0:1 dark, D10). Was a literal in the bundle. New (R2-O24).

tokens.name: accent-bar
tokens.usage: Floating bar background after a right answer. Text: text-primary. (PantasColors.floatingRight)

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Red rings, borders and badges: wrong answer ring, invalid field ring, red outline button. Red marks only a destructive action or something the learner got wrong or entered wrong. Not for text in dark (danger-text). (PantasColors.destructive)

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: Red text and icons for wrong, invalid or destructive. On surface-card, bg-page, danger-tint, danger-bar. (PantasColors.wrongText)

tokens.name: danger-text-hover
tokens.usage: Hover color of red ghost and outlined labels. Dark #F0807A holds 4.9:1 over its 8% wash on surface-modal and 5.6:1 on the card (R3-A07; CHANGE from danger-text, which fell to 4.1:1 in a dark dialog). (WebTokens.dangerTextHover)

tokens.name: danger-fill
tokens.usage: Filled destructive button and wrong-answer badge. Text on it: on-danger. (WebTokens.dangerFill)

tokens.name: danger-fill-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of the destructive button. (WebTokens.dangerHover)

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Wrong-answer wash only. An invalid field keeps surface-card. Text: danger-text or text-primary. (PantasColors.wrongTint)

tokens.name: danger-bar
tokens.usage: Floating bar background after a wrong answer. Text: text-primary. (PantasColors.floatingWrong)

tokens.name: danger-muted
tokens.usage: Light red of wrong answers in the UPCAT mock finale (scan and red ball). Graphic only. New: the finale drew #F4AFAF with no token.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text and marks on danger-fill. (PantasColors.onDestructive)

tokens.name: warning-text
tokens.usage: Orange text and icons for a heads-up: timer under five minutes, Unread, warning notice icon. Always with a word or icon. CHANGE (dark): #D9A400 to #F0A35A (7.9:1), so gold marks only Pro. (PantasColors.warningText)

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Background of the orange tag and the warning notice band (board .tago #FFF1E5). Dark value chosen. Text: warning-tint-text. New role.

tokens.name: warning-tint-text
tokens.usage: Text on warning-tint. Light is warning-text as the board draws it (4.7:1); dark chosen (8.8:1). New role.

tokens.name: pro
tokens.usage: Gold fill of the Pro mark. Always with on-pro text. Never a lone gold icon on white (2.2:1). (PantasColors.pro)

tokens.name: on-pro
tokens.usage: Text on the Pro mark. 7.4:1 on pro. New.

tokens.name: switch-off
tokens.usage: Off track of a switch, always with a 1.5px border-control ring. (css .sw) Equal to fill-skeleton by coincidence, not an alias (R3-O13).

tokens.name: switch-thumb
tokens.usage: Switch thumb, both themes. (PantasColors.switchThumb)

tokens.name: toast-bg
tokens.usage: Toast background. Light is ink; dark is a raised gray with a 1px edge in elev-toast so it separates from the dark page. CHANGE (dark): #1D1D1F (1.1:1 on the page) to #3A3A3C. (PantasColors.toastBackground)

tokens.name: toast-text
tokens.usage: Toast message text. (PantasColors.onToast)

tokens.name: toast-action
tokens.usage: Toast action link (Undo). 10.1:1 light, 6.8:1 dark. (PantasColors.toastAction)

tokens.name: toast-action-hover
tokens.usage: Hover well of the toast action: white at 10% over toast-bg. Was a literal in the bundle. New (R2-O24).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind dialogs, sheets and drawers. Light is ink at 32%; dark is black at 48%. CHANGE (dark): 28% to 48% so a dialog separates from the dark page. (WebRootModal literals)

tokens.name: scrim-search
tokens.usage: Lighter scrim behind the SearchOverlay, so the page stays readable under the results (SD_Search boards: ink at 22%). Dark is black at 40%. New (ruling 9).

tokens.name: liquid-start
tokens.usage: Start of the liquid gauge and exam-switch gradient. (PantasColors.liquidStart)

tokens.name: liquid-end
tokens.usage: End of the liquid gauge gradient. (PantasColors.liquidEnd)

tokens.name: hero-start
tokens.usage: Start of the teal gradient (Pro hero on the phone, topic-done card, share card). ST_ProPMA draws #0E8C77, folded into #0E8B76 (D129). New (ruling 10).

tokens.name: hero-mid
tokens.usage: Middle stop of the phone Pro hero gradient (40%). New (ruling 10).

tokens.name: hero-end
tokens.usage: End of the phone Pro hero gradient (ST_ProPMA #075548). New (ruling 10).

tokens.name: topic-done-end
tokens.usage: End of the topic-done card gradient (RD_TopicDone, RD_TopicShort #075C4E). New (ruling 10).

tokens.name: share-end
tokens.usage: End of the share-card gradient (L_Share, WR_*: #064C40 folded into #0A4D42, 0.6 CIEDE2000). Sharing is deferred; the token documents the approved value. New (ruling 10).

tokens.name: on-hero
tokens.usage: Text on a teal gradient. Titles 3:1 or better on the start (large text); body text sits on the middle and end stops (5.3:1 and up). New (ruling 10).

tokens.name: on-hero-secondary
tokens.usage: Icons and secondary text on a teal gradient (ST_ProPMA #BFF0E4). 3.4:1 on the start (icons), 4.2:1 on the middle stop. New (ruling 10).

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Accuracy step 1: below 45%. Lighter (light) or dimmer (dark) means lower accuracy. 3.0:1 and 3.0:1 on surface-card, light and dark. The number is always printed beside it. CHANGE: new values so every step holds 3:1.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Accuracy step 2: 45 to 54%. Lighter (light) or dimmer (dark) means lower accuracy. 3.5:1 and 3.5:1 on surface-card, light and dark. The number is always printed beside it. CHANGE: new values so every step holds 3:1.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Accuracy step 3: 55 to 64%. Lighter (light) or dimmer (dark) means lower accuracy. 4.0:1 and 4.6:1 on surface-card, light and dark. The number is always printed beside it. CHANGE: new values so every step holds 3:1.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Accuracy step 4: 65 to 74%. Lighter (light) or dimmer (dark) means lower accuracy. 4.6:1 and 6.0:1 on surface-card, light and dark. The number is always printed beside it. CHANGE: new values so every step holds 3:1.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Accuracy step 5: 75% and up. Lighter (light) or dimmer (dark) means lower accuracy. 5.3:1 and 7.6:1 on surface-card, light and dark. The number is always printed beside it. CHANGE: new values so every step holds 3:1. Aliases accent on purpose: the top step is the brand teal (R3-O13).

tokens.name: figure-bg
tokens.usage: Backing for question figures. Stays white in dark. (PantasColors.figureBackground)

tokens.name: figure-reader-bg
tokens.usage: Backing for reader illustrations, which keep their printed background in both themes. (PantasColors.readerFigureBackground)

tokens.name: figure-viewer-bg
tokens.usage: Flutter figure viewer stage (black). The web viewer uses figure-scrim over the page. The Flutter viewer reads it (R4-O11). (PantasColors.figureViewerBackground)

tokens.name: figure-on-viewer
tokens.usage: Controls on the figure viewer. (PantasColors.onFigureViewer)

tokens.name: figure-scrim
tokens.usage: Scrim over the page behind the figure viewer. (WebTokens.figureScrim)

tokens.name: figure-caption
tokens.usage: Caption text on the figure viewer (on figure-scrim). (WebTokens.figureCaption)

tokens.name: reader-body
tokens.usage: Lesson body text, one step below reader-strong. On surface-card and bg-page. (PantasColors.readerBody)

tokens.name: reader-strong
tokens.usage: Bold and display math in lessons. (PantasColors.readerStrong)

tokens.name: reader-deep
tokens.usage: Solution panel inside a lesson example card. (PantasColors.readerDeep)

tokens.name: reader-note-text
tokens.usage: Text of reader note cards on accent-tint. (PantasColors.readerNoteText)

tokens.name: reader-mistake
tokens.usage: Icon and rule of the reader's common-mistake card (Traps to Watch For). Red is allowed: it marks what learners get wrong. Renamed from reader-warn. (PantasColors.readerWarn)

tokens.name: reader-mistake-tint
tokens.usage: Background of the common-mistake card. Renamed from reader-warn-tint. (PantasColors.readerWarnTint)

tokens.name: reader-mistake-text
tokens.usage: Text of the common-mistake card. Renamed from reader-warn-text. (PantasColors.readerWarnText)
